class.name: InterDVDPGC
class.brief_description: Program Chain: cells plus pre/post instruction arrays.
class.description: PGC pre/post and cell-post sites are written into the IFO. First Play (FPC) is a PGC on [InterDVDProject]. Set [member Resource.resource_name] so button destination dropdowns can label this title. The inspector [b]DVD Authoring[/b] buttons append a video cell or a Jump Title highlight.

method.name: add_cell_from_video
method.description: Appends a cell whose [member InterDVDCell.source_path] is [param path] and returns it. Each cell is chapter N in this title.

method.name: add_jump_title_button
method.description: Appends a Jump Title highlight button targeting [param title_n] and returns it.

members.member: Optional highlight buttons overlaid on this title (for example a Next Scene control). Written as PCI HLI in the title VOB.
Ordered cells in this PGC. Each cell is muxed into the title VOB; cell N is chapter N (PGN N / PTT N).
Optional 16-entry PGC palette written at PGC offset [code]0xA4[/code]. Empty keeps the default golds.
Forced-selected title-domain button when this PGC has highlight buttons.
Next PGC number. Titles with highlight buttons default to looping this PGC when unset.
PGC post commands (used after the last cell).
Still time in seconds written on the last cell ([code]255[/code] = infinite).
Parental id for TT_SRPT and PGCI search pointer.
Prohibited user operations written at PGC offset 8.
Go-Up PGC number at IFO offset [code]0xA0[/code].
